Background: (Jonathan)
Learn the lore from both source materials (Minecraft and Pokemon). Build the world of minecraft, a free roam where the main character is a combination of Ash and Steve.

Assets: (Mio)
Assets: Getting the elements that will be edited and used in the creation of the mod: - Characters, text, animation, 3d models, fonts, audio, etc. Obtaining everything that will be used in order to achieve the results, aka also the things the audience will view.

Body Frame: (Isaias) 
Build/configure: Put the blocky world together, add an Ash-Steve character so he can walk around, and set up the basic controls for throwing Pokéballs and catching Pokémon as well of building like in a Minecraft world.

Output: (Daniel)
The output is for are mod to allow the player/consumer to be able to throw a poke ball to a Minecraft mob it will also make a custom world when loaded for the player with bits of Pokémon while still looking like Minecraft.

Results: (Paul)
Results - We have achieved the results we wanted. We wanted to make a mod pack for the video game Minecraft where we added a poke-ball from Pokemon.
huddle.tech: My team has agreed on Unity, C#, Unity Hub, package manager, We chose this because this well give us the results we are looking for a mod. We also have the most experience with Unity we understand it.
huddle.code:

Class | Responsibility | GameObject
PokeBalltem  | allows people to throw the poke balls. | poke ball 
Pokeballprojectiles  | handles the poke ball  | projectiles 
MobCapturesystem | Detects and captures Minecraft mobs  | Minecraft mob 

Classes & components
Class  |  Responsibility | GameObject
pokeBallCount : int   |  Number of Poké Balls the player has |   PokeBallItem
targetMob : Entity | Stores the Minecraft mob being targeted   | PokeBallProjectile
captureChance : float  | Determines the chance of capturing a mob   | MobCaptureSystem

huddle.reuse: We can reuse the organization patters we are learning/learned from the 6 videos we saw on game development using Unity and Talsta. We can also reuse the story element to build upon what we have and use the skills we have learned to revise our work. We can also continue to further use AI to keep us on track and add new ideas.
huddle.boardNotes: We all had planned to call over Zoom, however, we ran into technical difficulties so we decided to switch to Discord instead. We were on a call for over 2 hours working out our goals and coming up with ideas for our creation. In the huddle board we discussed the pipelines we want to use and how to move forward in this assignment. We talked about what elements we want to include in our game, and we also created task boards to help us stay organized. We gave each other different jobs so we can work on separate things, we also discussed how we will be moving forward from this point on as a team.

Output: (Daniel)
The output is for are mod to allow the player/consumer to be able to throw a poke ball to a Minecraft mob it will also make a custom world when loaded for the player with bits of Pokémon while still looking like Minecraft.

Results - We have achieved the results we wanted. We wanted to make a mod pack for the video game Minecraft where we added a poke-ball from Pokemon.
